メレムの占いにあった、大穴で巡り合うすごい幸運！<br>どんなもんに出会うか楽し:
Melem's divination said we'd meet incredible luck in the Great Pit!
I can't wait to see what we'll find!
占いの結果はあくまでも道標です。<br>それを元にどのような道を進むのかは、それ:
The results of divination are only a guide.
Which path you take from it is up to each person's decision.
まだ気づかれてないみたいだが、どうするか。<br>２人がかりなら倒せるかもしれな:
It doesn't seem to have noticed us yet — what should we do?
We might be able to defeat it together, but...?
少しお待ちください。<br>進むべき未来を占ってみましょう。:
Please wait a moment.
I'll divine the future we should follow.
メレムが手を振ると数枚のカードが飛び出し、<br>するりと彼女の手に収まった。:
When Melem waved her hand, a few cards flew out,
slipping smoothly back into her palm.
……なるほど。<br>焦りは禁物、じっと待つのが良い、と出ました。:
…I see.
The reading says: don't rush—it's best to wait patiently.
ふむ……それが占いの結果か。<br>よし、メレムの言う通りにしてみよう。:
Hmm… so that's the result of the divination.
All right, let's do as Melem says.
ええ、動かないでじーっと、じーっと……: Yes—don't move, stay very still… very, very still…
おっと、別のモンスターが寄ってきたぞ。<br>敵が増えたが、これでいいのか！？:
Whoa—another monster's coming over.
There are more enemies now; is this really okay!?
モンスター同士が戦い始めたっ！？<br>これが占いの導いた未来か……！:
The monsters have started fighting each other!?!
Is this the future the divination foretold…!?
さあ、この先に待つ幸運を探しに参りましょう。: Come, let's go find the good fortune waiting ahead.
順調に進んではいるが、幸運ってのはどこにあるのだろうな。<br>大雑把でもいいか:
We're making good progress, but where is this 'good luck' supposed to be?
Could you do a rough reading to tell us which direction to head?
ええ、構いませんよ。<br>ではこの水盆で……:
Sure, that's fine.
Then with this basin…
あ、足元に気をつけろよ。<br>この辺り、ちょっと地面がぬかるんでるから。:
Ah, watch your step.
The ground around here is a bit muddy.
水盆を持って両手の塞がったメレムは、<br>泥まみれの地面で盛大に足をすべらせた:
Melem, her hands full with the basin,
took a spectacular tumble on the mud-slicked ground.
大丈夫かっ！？<br>悪い、言うのが遅れた！:
Are you okay!?
Sorry, I should've warned you sooner!
い、いいえ、ただ転んだだけですから……っ！？<br>あああああぁぁぁぁぁ～っ！！:
N-no, I'm fine, I just fell…!?
Aaaaaaaahhhhhh~!!
ど、どうした！？ <br>怪我か、モンスターか、それとも罠かっ！？:
W-what happened!?
Are you hurt, is there a monster, or a trap!?
水盆に……泥が混じっちゃった……！<br>これじゃ占えないよぉ……:
Mud got into the basin...!
I can't do a reading like this…
メレムは涙目で水盆を掲げた。<br>転んだ時に入ったのだろう、水にたくさんの泥が:
Merem held the basin up, eyes brimming with tears.
It must have splashed in when she fell—there's a lot of mud mixed into the water.
……ただ泥が入っただけだろう。<br>水を入れ替えればいいじゃないか。:
…It's just mud.
Why don't you just change the water?
これは繊細な魔道具なんです～！ こんなにたくさん泥が混ざったら、<br>ちゃんと:
This is a delicate magical instrument~! If this much mud gets in,
you have to clean it properly or you won't be able to see the future~!
うう、まだ魔導書もあるし、カードだって……。<br>落ち着いて、落ち着いて……:
Ugh, there's still the magic book, and the cards...
Calm down, calm down...
……おほん。<br>では占いましょう。進むべき道は……こちらですね。:
…Ahem.
Now then, let's read the fortune. The path we should take is... this one, right?
ええと、メレム？<br>さっきの情けない姿はなんなんだ？:
Er, Merem?
What was that pathetic sight earlier?
き、気にしないでください。<br>占いがある限り、私は問題ありませんので。:
D-Don't pay it any mind.
As long as I can do the reading, I'm fine.
それは占えなくなったら問題が起きるって意味じゃないのか！？<br>本当に大丈夫な:
Doesn't that mean there'll be trouble if you can't read anymore!?
Are you really alright!?
上につながる道か、下に向かう道か。<br>進むべきはこのカードが示すでしょう……:
A path leading upward, or one that goes down.
This card should tell us which way to go...!?
吹き抜けた突風がメレムの手からカードを奪い去る。<br>空中を舞ったカードは大穴:
A gust of wind swept through and snatched the card from Merem's hand.
The card spun through the air and fell far down into the great pit.
私のカードがぁ……！<br>大事にしてたのに～！！:
My card...!
I treasured it so much~!!
俺が誘ったせい、だよな。<br>なんかすまん……:
It's my fault for inviting you, isn't it.
Sorry about that...
へ、平気です。この魔導書で占いましょう。<br>私たちが行くべきは……下、ですね:
I-It's fine. Let's use this magic book to do the reading.
The way we should go is... down, right?
この辺りは水場がある。<br>落ちないように気をつけよう。:
There's water nearby.
Be careful not to fall.
はい、もしも落ちたら魔導書まで使えなくなりますから……: Yes, if you fall you'll even lose the use of the magic book...
っ！ 司令官、気をつけてください！<br>上から何か落ちてきますっ！:
Ah! Commander, watch out!
Something's falling from above!
ガラガラという音が響き、水場へと大きな岩が転がり落ちた。<br>幸運にも２人にぶ:
A clattering sound rang out as a large boulder tumbled into the water.
Fortunately it didn't hit the two of them—
うわっ、ここまで水が飛んできたぞっ！: Whoa, the water splashed all the way here!
あ、あああっ！ 魔導書が濡れてびしゃびしゃに～～！！！<br>これじゃ占えないよ:
A-ahh! The magic book's soaked through~~!!!
We can't read the fortune like this~!
……やられたか。<br>それ、濡れたらもう使えないのか？:
…We were had.
If it's wet, can't you use it anymore?
ちゃんと乾かせば大丈夫だけど～！<br>濡れたまま開いたらページが破れちゃう～！:
If you let it dry properly it'll be fine~!
But if you open it while it's still wet, the pages will tear~!
でも占える道具は……まだダイスがある！<br>これを転がして、私たちの未来を見通:
But we still have a die for divination!
Roll it and let's see our future!
……この大穴でダイスを転がすって時点で、<br>俺にすら未来が分かるんだが。:
…If you're going to roll a die into that huge chasm,
even I can tell what's going to happen.
あ、あああっ！<br>ダイスが転がって、割れた地面の間にーっ！:
A-agh!
The die rolled into the gap between the cracked ground—!
どうしよう、道具が全部なくなっちゃった……<br>これじゃ占えない～！ うわぁ～:
What do I do, all my tools are gone...
I can't do readings like this~! Waaah~~~!!!
落ち着け、そこまで慌てることはないって。<br>占いは道標でしかないって言ったの:
Calm down, there's no need to panic that much.
You're the one, Merem, who said fortune-telling is only a signpost, right?
無理なの～！ 私には占いがないとダメ～！！: No way~! I can't do this without my fortune-telling~!!
本当にポンコツになってるな……。<br>どうしてそこまで占いを頼る？:
You're really becoming hopeless...
Why are you so dependent on divination?
うぅ……私の故郷はすごく占いを大事にする国で、<br>ず～っと占いを大切にしてき:
Ugh... My homeland is a country that places great importance on divination,
and we've always treasured fortune-telling.
毎日の夕食も、身につけるアクセサリーの色も、<br>なんでも占いを参考にしてるん:
Even my daily dinner and the color of the accessories I wear,
I use divination as a guide for everything.
メレムが個人的に占い頼みの生活をしてたんじゃなく、<br>国単位でみんなそんな感:
So it wasn't just you personally relying on fortune-telling, Merem—
the whole country was like that?
そうですぅ～！ 国の政治も軍事も経済も！ <br>全部占いを参考にしてたんだから:
Yes~! Politics, the military, the economy!
They all took fortune-telling into account~~!!!
なんだその独特な国！？<br>あくまで参考にしてるだけなんだよな！？:
What kind of bizarre country is that!?
They were only using it as a reference, right!?
もちろん占いで決めてたわけじゃないけど～、<br>ちゃんと占いを大事にしてたんで:
Of course they weren't deciding everything by fortune-telling~,
but they truly valued it~!
私が前線基地に来たのも占いの結果なの～！<br>大いなる災いを防ぐべく力になるべ:
My coming to the front-line base was also the result of a divination~!
It said I should lend my strength to prevent a great calamity!
だけどこっちでも占いのお仕事はたくさんで忙しいし、<br>さっきみたいにモンスタ:
But even here there's lots of fortune-telling work and I'm busy,
and sometimes I even have to fight monsters like earlier~!!
運命の中心になりそうな司令官を見つけたのに、<br>一緒に来たら占いの道具が全部:
I found a commander who seemed like the center of fate,
but when I came with them all my divination tools stopped working...
うう、来るんじゃなかった……故郷に帰りたいよぉ……: Ugh, I shouldn't have come... I want to go back home...
メレムが弱りきってる……。<br>さっきまであんなにクールな占い師だったのに……:
Merem's completely deflated...
She was such a cool fortune-teller just a moment ago...
大穴で巡り合う幸運ってのは、どこにあるんだ？<br>この状況はどう考えても幸運じ:
Where's this so-called 'lucky encounter' in this cavern?
No matter how I look at it, this doesn't seem lucky…
ううぅ～！ 占えない時にどうしたらいいのか、<br>私に占わせてよぉ～！！！:
Uuu~! What am I supposed to do when I can't read the future?
Let me do a reading—pleeease!!!
それは無理、かなあ……: I don't think that's going to be possible…
